key_terms.جَنَّةٍ: Paradise, the abode of eternal bliss

ai.seo_question: What does the 'high empyrean' or 'high Jannah' refer to in Shia Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the supreme status of the righteous, particularly the Ahl al-Bayt, whose spiritual elevation mirrors the physical grandeur of Paradise. It reflects the concept of 'Illiyyin' or the highest register, signifying that true piety leads to an exalted abode beyond ordinary comprehension. This description serves as both a promise for the faithful and a contrast to the fate of the disbelievers mentioned in the surrounding verses.
